GT2 concerns the Section 3.2 gradient analysis and its failure to reflect coupling with the mean logit as claimed; neither finding addresses this locus—finding 2 instead targets an unrelated inconsistency between Corollary 3.4 and Table 1's use of K vs M,N denominators.

Describes a plausible inconsistency between Corollary 3.4's K-based decomposition and Table 1's M/N-based ablation, but this is not one of the listed ground-truth defects.
